summary: Gulf Resources, Inc., a Nevada-incorporated bromine and crude salt producer operating in Shandong, China, filed a Form 8-K on October 6, 2026 reporting that on October 1, 2026 it received a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications staff letter confirming it had regained compliance with the periodic filing requirement under Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The Company issued a press release the same day (Exhibit 99.1). No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. The filing closes a delisting-compliance event, not a new transaction; watch for any residual deficiency or future filing lapses.
